title: Docker job fails to download pinned checkout action from codeload.github.com
signature: resource temporarily unavailable codeload.github.com failed to download action archive after 3 attempts|Network

failed_jobs.name: Docker
failed_jobs.symptom: Failed to download pinned checkout action archive from codeload.github.com after 3 retries with backoff

key_errors: 2026-10-30T18:42:22.9566655Z ##[warning]Failed to download action 'https://codeload.github.com/ababushk/checkout/tar.gz/9bec46a94a83db82acd4303e7627d88db71402a5'. Error: Resource temporarily unavailable (codeload.github.com:443)
root_cause: The 'Docker' job in the Linux RISC-V workflow needs to download a second pinned action reference (ababushk/checkout@9bec46a94a83db82acd4303e7627d88db71402a5) mid-job via codeload.github.com. codeload.github.com returned transient 'Resource temporarily unavailable' errors on all 3 built-in download attempts (with backoff), exhausting the retry budget before the GitHub-side transient outage/throttling cleared. This is identical in signature to a prior occurrence on 2026-10-30 (run 41011833528), indicating this specific action-archive download path is susceptible to recurring codeload.github.com transient unavailability, independent of the commit or PR content.
reproduction_steps: N/A - this is an upstream GitHub Actions infrastructure (codeload.github.com) transient-availability issue unrelated to repository source code; re-running the job after the outage clears typically succeeds.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'Docker' job/workflow; codeload.github.com outages are typically transient and clear within minutes.
Consider mirroring or vendoring the 'ababushk/checkout' action (or pinning via a local composite action) to avoid a second external codeload.github.com fetch mid-job.

Monitor GitHub status page for codeload.github.com during correlated failures; if recurrence increases, consider adding a repository-level retry/backoff wrapper around action downloads or caching the action in a self-hosted runner image.
prevention_strategies: Reduce dependency on secondary just-in-time action downloads during job execution by pre-baking frequently used actions into the custom Docker runner image, or by vendoring the pinned action's code directly into the repository/workflow. This removes the runtime dependency on codeload.github.com succeeding mid-job.
historical_context: Identical signature observed on 2026-10-30 in run 41011833528 (same 'Docker' job, same pinned 'ababushk/checkout' action, same codeload.github.com 'Resource temporarily unavailable' error after 3 attempts). This is now a confirmed recurring pattern (2nd occurrence) rather than an isolated incident, though still consistent with transient upstream GitHub infrastructure issues rather than a code or configuration defect.
